_about: The comparison fields and their definitions.

entered_by_you.name: Company name (from config/competitors.csv)
entered_by_you.type: Self, 1st Degree, 2nd Degree or 3rd Degree (definitions in config/discovery.json), plus an optional note (from config/competitors.csv)

extracted_from_page.definition: What kind of product this is and the discipline it serves, in the company's own words.
Which delivery platforms the page says the product runs on. Allowed values: Web, VR, AR, MR, Mobile, Desktop, Physical hardware, Projection or immersive room.
Specific product features the page claims (for example case authoring, reporting, case library, multiplayer). A list of short phrases.
Who the page says the product is for (for example nursing schools, hospitals, EMS).
The main benefit or outcome the company promises, summarized in one or two sentences.
The headline or slogan, copied exactly as written.
Any published price, plan, or pricing model. Expected to be not_found on most sites.

filled_automatically.source_url: The page the evidence came from
filled_automatically.checked_at: Date and time the page was downloaded
filled_automatically.status: Per field: found, unclear, not_found, or unverified (quote not present in the saved page)
